hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qi 'Co-Authored-By'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"BLOCKED: Do not add Co-Authored-By to commits. Remove it and retry."}}'; fi

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && go vet ./... 2>&1; VET=$?; if [ $VET -ne 0 ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"BLOCKED: go vet failed. Fix vet warnings before committing."}}'; fi

INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -q 'git tag' && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -q 'git tag -'; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"BLOCKED: Use annotated tags (git tag -a v0.X.0 -m summary). No lightweight tags."}}'; fi

FILE_PATH=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE_PATH" in *.go) LINT_OUTPUT=$(bash scripts/lint-naming.sh "$FILE_PATH" 2>&1) || { echo "$LINT_OUTPUT" | head -20 >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0
